evidence.title: Claude for teams. - by Ruben Hassid - How to AI

name: Claude for teams.
summary: Seven-day playbook for rolling out Claude across a team with Projects and prompt templates.
description: Week-long playbook for setting up Claude for a team: choosing the team plan (minimum 5 seats, up to 150, Standard or Premium), building one Claude Project per recurring deliverable with the right context and instructions, creating prompt templates, testing the setup, converting one champion, and rolling it out by Friday. Part of Ruben Hassid's How to AI newsletter.
contains: day-by-day plan from Monday to Friday
team plan: minimum 5 seats, up to 150
